LEARNINGOBJECTIVE

Calculate areas of regions
defined by polar curves using
definite integrals. bc only
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
CHA-5.D.1
The concept of calculating areas in rectangular
coordinates can be extended to polar
coordinates. bc only
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in
area or volume over an interval.
